description: Tell gocushy what was spent on a network for a period, so Trace can compute ROAS against real revenue. gocushy deliberately does NOT connect to ad accounts — you already have that access, so you fetch the spend and report it here. Idempotent per (source, campaign, period): re-reporting the same period updates it instead of double-counting, so it is safe to re-run. Omit `campaign` for all campaigns on that source. Report the real figure from the ad platform; never estimate one.

campaign.description: Omit for all campaigns on this source

source.description: Network, e.g. meta, google, tiktok (spellings like 'Facebook' are normalised)

name: report_ad_spend
title: Report ad spend (Trace)
